name: color-picker
title: Color Picker
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: An OKLCH color picker: lightness, chroma and hue sliders painted with the color's own gradients. Given a background (contrastWith), it shows the WCAG ratio, hatches the lightness that fails AA, marks the AA/AAA thresholds and offers "Fix to AA/AAA" buttons that jump to the nearest passing lightness keeping the hue. A grid of preset swatches (Tailwind's palette by default, or your own via swatches) sets the color in one click, hatching the presets that fail AA. ColorPicker is a swatch that opens it in a popover; ColorPickerPanel renders it inline.
